unit.title: The Future, Personal Goals and B1 Integration

theory.title: Comunicación clara: peticiones y preguntas indirectas
theory.explanation: Usa could y would para formular peticiones más educadas. En las preguntas indirectas, conserva el orden de una oración afirmativa después de la expresión interrogativa: Could you tell me where the office is? (¿Podrías decirme dónde está la oficina?). Para pedir algo con cortesía, usa would you mind + verbo en -ing.
theory.tip: En preguntas indirectas, sujeto antes del verbo. Would you mind + verbo en -ing.

content.passage: At the reception desk, a visitor asked politely for information. She said, 'Could you tell me where the training room is?' The receptionist showed her a map. The visitor then asked whether she needed to sign a form. She also asked, 'Would you mind checking my appointment time?' The receptionist confirmed the details and explained how the online system worked.

items.prompt: Ask politely where a meeting room is.
items.modelAnswer: Excuse me, could you tell me where meeting room four is, please? I have a meeting at ten, and I don't want to interrupt another group by entering the wrong room.

items.prompt: Request that someone checks some information.
items.modelAnswer: Would you mind checking these figures before I send the report? I want to make sure the totals are correct. Thank you for taking a look.

items.prompt: Ask indirectly when an appointment starts.
items.modelAnswer: Could you tell me what time the appointment starts? I have the date in my calendar, but I can't find the starting time in the confirmation email.

items.prompt: Ask someone to explain how a system works.
items.modelAnswer: Excuse me, could you explain how this booking system works? I have entered my details, but I am not sure how to choose a time slot.

items.prompt: Request that someone speaks more slowly.
items.modelAnswer: Sorry, would you mind speaking a little more slowly? I want to make sure I understand the instructions correctly. Thank you for your patience.

items.prompt: Ask which form you need to complete.
items.modelAnswer: Could you let me know which form I need to complete to change my address? I have found two different forms on the website and don't want to send the wrong one.

items.prompt: Ask whether a shop or office is open.
items.modelAnswer: Could you tell me whether the office is open this afternoon? I need to collect a document, and I would like to check before travelling there.

items.prompt: Politely ask where you should sign.
items.modelAnswer: Would you mind showing me where I should sign, please? I have read the document, but I want to make sure I sign in the correct place.

items.prompt: Request a change to an appointment.
items.modelAnswer: Would it be possible to move my appointment from Tuesday morning to Thursday afternoon? I have a work meeting at the original time. I apologise for any inconvenience.

items.prompt: Explain how you would ask for help in a formal situation.
items.modelAnswer: In a formal situation, I would greet the person, explain why I need help and ask a clear question. I would use polite expressions such as 'Could you please…?' and thank them for their time.

content.audioTranscript: A: How have you found the course? B: Very useful. I've developed new skills and gained more confidence. A: What has helped you most? B: The practical experience and regular practice have made a difference. A: Have you shared your opinions in class? B: Yes, and we've solved several problems together. A: What are your plans for the future? B: I want to achieve my goals and continue making progress.
